# `slogs`

Organize SLURM output files using AnnData pipeline run metadata and verify against recorded jobs

- Wrapper: [`job_slurmlogs.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_slurmlogs.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-analysis`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.slurmlogs`

## Inputs

- general.anndata_path with general.anndata_uns_log_key run_log entries containing slurm.job_id/slurm.job_name
- Current working directory containing slurm-<job_id>.out files

## Outputs

- general.slurm_logs_folder with renamed logs and *_Unverified flags for unmatched files
- general.slurm_logs_folder/slurmlogs_manifest.csv
- outputs/<execution_id>_Legacy_SLURM_Log_Migration/ stage report under sbt

## Configuration

- general, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl slogs
```
